ch.h:
Hello, Satsu here once again. I watched an anime once, called Tales of zestiria, A pretty good anime, but, my topic today is not really about that anime, rather something I heard within it. It really is something universal, that has been there in front of us for quite a long time, and we all may have pondered about it, but, never really, at least I never really properly sorted out my answers for it, so having done that, I thought I should share it somewhere, after all, why not, sharing is caring.

So the topic isn’t really a surprise because the thing that I want to talk about, is literally the title of the video. Yes, Sorey, the main character of the anime said, “Humans are imperfect hence precious.” Hearing that, I actually paused the show and thought to myself, couldn’t help but laugh as well, how true yet messed up it sounded. You see, he was fighting the main villain, who was an accumulation of masses of evil, malevolence they called it. Basically human negativity turned into physical entities that the main characters fought. Kinda dumb because he kept saying he will purge all of the malevolence, apparently I guess he hasn’t learned about humanity properly. Either ways, back to what he said, and let us talk more broad now, let’s leave the anime aside now, and come to the real world.

It is not really the first time I have seen a human defending humans for being shit. But then again we can’t blame them, they have to protect and make a logic and reason for their existence and actions because that anchors them properly. Without it, they will just lose their mind. Among these reasons, is the most popular one, that many would know by the term, crown of creation. Humans believe they are the best creation, or best beings out there. This has been supported by texts from all 3 of the major religions of the world. And obviously personal human feelings and thinking as well. That’s fine by me, I don’t have an issue with it, because, I guess I myself am a human but literally, the intelligence and complexity we humans have, kinda is amazing. Oh and by complexity I mean, making dumb decision while being an intelligent being. You know, it is also called freedom in other words. But this brings me down to the main point, the dual nature.

Like say, we slaughter animals for our own means, and say it is just because the animals were meant or made for us. I am a muslim and my religios clearly says, god has created he animals for the humans to feast upon. Although there are some ethics and morals behind it all but not gonna go in detail still, I mean, we are killing them sooo… you know…. Now imagine, like those big hot Hollywood movies, Aliens have come upon, or not really aliens but lets just say, some super high intelligent specie because obviously aliens will give you the idea of those greenish things but they aint scary so…. , yeah, like those things in that movie called Prometheus, or you know, that guy who came down in x man apocalypse, etc… so yeah, they have appeared on earth, and now, they are out for blood, because why not, it is fun for them, or perhaps they need us for experiments or maybe even food. Now in shows like these, humans are portrayed as such victims that you even feel sorry for the worst of shits. And the humans claim it is injustice to them and such, but isn’t that the same as we are doing. So as long as we do it, it is alright, but when a higher being than us does it, it is wrong. And there really is no special logic about it, it is just, humans are firkin selfish, that is how there mind works.

Since humans are the corwn of creation, they r to be protected even if they mess u, big time, or are the cause of all problems, fine, that is a rule set by us, but we are also perfection loving and would always choose the best for us. We talk nature is justice because it is on the side of man, but when this changes, heck, Fish nature, so, basically what we humans have done is, set our answer that we are right by default in every situation. And that is why, we are precious, because yeah, this world will be nothing without the humans, what a joke seriously.

Thinking and speaking on this, Im slowly starting to realize that there is not really a particular answer, but just, you know, me nagging about nothing, so I guess this nag is the answer. Humans just don’t care about the real rules and logic, what they care about is stuff they want or is related to them, and that becomes the basis for judgement. Where humans as a whole can never be wrong and even if they are wrong, we shrug it off as complexity, beauty of nature, paradoxes and diversity and how humans are unique. Such pretty terms all to hide our own weaknesses and to give us an excuse to stay true to our selfish cores.

Hence why, we humans collectively are not really that precious as we think, we are just a life form, and no one would give a shit if it’s gone, no but us lol. So we should get off our high horse, admit that we are just fending and making a place on this planet, dominating it, in a so called war, that is one sided with humans on the top. And that, by no means makes us precious, as what soery, the mc of the anime was fighting was but a human too. So as the root of evil, if we cut down that root, we aint doing anyone but us a favor and doing what we shouldn’t have started to begin with. And that brings my complain letter to a close, sorry for a pessimistic talk, but hope you got something from it, because in the end, just a small food for thought is also good for the human mind.

Let us aim forward and PLUS ULTRA. Satsu, over and out.
